notes: SR115 Juttu Home (juttu.be), Dutch-language multi-department JBC lifestyle site (fashion + home-deco + gifts + food). Access: direct HTTP fetch worked throughout, no WAF/blocking; robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (checked first). Checked: main nav (all 8 top-level items: New collection, Bestsellers, Dames, Heren, Home-deco, Cadeaus, Merken, De wereld van Juttu), homepage teaser banners, and the full category sitemap (https://www.juttu.be/sitemap/category-1.xml, ~1000+ URLs) for bestseller/top-seller/populair/meest-verkocht equivalents. Found exactly ONE genuine Bestsellers PLP: the top-nav 'Bestsellers' item links to https://www.juttu.be/nl/c/trends/must-haves.html (backend category path Trends > Must haves, ids 12010;12535). This is site-wide (not home-deco-specific) - it appeared as a JBC/Juttu-wide 'must haves' curated bestseller listing, consistent with the sort-by-bestselling default seen in SITE.Config (lister.sort default key 'bestselling'). Verified as a real PLP via the embedded lister JSON (script data-hypernova-key=AEMScenes... comment-wrapped JSON): title:'Bestsellers', urlState.defaultFilter='categories:c(12010;12535)', totalPages:2, itemCount:76. Checked the sitemap specifically for a home-deco-scoped bestsellers/must-haves variant (pattern home-deco/.../must-haves|bestsell|populair) - none exists, confirming this is a single undifferentiated listing, not split by department. No other candidate URLs found (no /best-sellers, /topsellers, /populair as separate nodes - 'Populaire merken'/'Nieuwe merken' in nav are brand-popularity submenus, not product bestseller listings, and were excluded as out of scope).
